This guide summarises driving routes across Vellmora for visitors and new residents. Ferries link the main island with the smaller isles, and timetables change with the seasons. Parking in town centres is usually limited to short stays during the day. By road, Drennick is 84 km from Port Ilvane.

Winter storms occasionally close exposed coastal sections for a few hours at a time. By road, Thornquay is 137 km from Port Ilvane. Road signs are written in plain block capitals and are easy to read. Speed cameras operate near schools and in the centre of every town.

Cyclists share many rural roads, so drivers should take care on bends. Most main roads on the island are two lanes wide and follow the coast. Fuel stations are spread fairly evenly, though some inland stretches have none.
